recognize_zh: EBUS-TBNA 淋巴結抹片在出血背景中，出現與淋巴球不同、黏合成團且核重疊的上皮樣細胞群（1a），以及排成小團、局部呈微濾泡狀的圓核細胞（1b）；淋巴結內出現外來的黏合性細胞團，就該想到轉移癌，濾泡樣排列則提示甲狀腺來源。
features: Composite of two panels (Figure 1a, 1b) of EBUS-TBNA smears with a heavily hemorrhagic background
Figure 1a: large cohesive, crowded cluster of cells with overlapping oval nuclei and syncytial arrangement
Figure 1b: small cohesive clusters of cells with uniform round to oval nuclei, focally forming microfollicle-like groups
Cells are larger than and cohere unlike background lymphocytes; moderate pale cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Nuclear grooves are not reliably resolved at this magnification and image quality
describe_en: EBUS-guided transbronchial needle aspirate smears from a hilar lymph node show a hemorrhagic background containing cohesive clusters of atypical epithelial cells foreign to lymph node. One panel shows a crowded aggregate with nuclear overlapping, while the other shows smaller groups of cells with round to oval nuclei focally arranged in microfollicular structures. Fine nuclear details such as grooves and pseudoinclusions cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. The findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; the follicular arrangement supports a thyroid primary, which should be confirmed with thyroglobulin/TTF-1 immunocytochemistry on a cell block.

ddx.vs: Also forms cohesive clusters in hilar nodes but typically shows 3-D acinar/papillary groups with prominent nucleoli and is TTF-1 positive but thyroglobulin and PAX8 negative.
Benign bronchial cells from the needle track form flat honeycomb or columnar strips with cilia and terminal bars, lacking nuclear overlap and follicle formation.
Shows loosely cohesive small cells with scant cytoplasm, nuclear molding, salt-and-pepper chromatin and crush artifact rather than follicles.
Epithelioid histiocyte clusters have elongated, footprint-shaped nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm, without follicular architecture.
